## Runs 6–7 — D = 0 SdH spot checks, raw transport

Both 1D sweeps completed (run 6: +3.2×10¹² cm⁻², 0→10 T; run 7: −1.2×10¹² cm⁻², 10→0.3 T). The plots use the measured drain current, `sr0_X/−1e6`, to form signed `Rxx = sr1_X/I` on the hardwired B_1–B_2 pair; gate currents and temperature are read from the same TSVs. Run 5 supplies the region-A D = 0 calibration; the absolute density scale remains the geometry prior.

# Runs 6 and 7: raw, gain-divided four-terminal traces before FFT interpretation.
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 7), sharex='col')
for row, (fid, n) in enumerate(((6, +3.2), (7, -1.2))):
    q = run(fid)
    print(summarize_run(q))
    B = q.col('magnet_field')
    I = q.col('sr0_X') / -1e6
    R = q.col('sr1_X') / I
    axs[row, 0].plot(B, R, lw=0.7)
    axs[row, 0].set(ylabel='signed Rxx (ohm)', title=f'run {fid}: n={n:+.1f}e12, D=0')
    axs[row, 1].plot(B, I * 1e9, lw=0.7, label='drain I (nA)')
    axs[row, 1].plot(B, q.col('T_sample'), lw=0.7, label='sample T (K)')
    axs[row, 1].legend(fontsize=8)
    axs[row, 1].set_title('raw current and temperature')
    print(f'run {fid}: R range {np.nanmin(R):.1f}..{np.nanmax(R):.1f} ohm, '
          f'I median {np.nanmedian(I)*1e9:.2f} nA, T {q.col("T_sample").min():.3f}..{q.col("T_sample").max():.3f} K; '
          f'|I_gate|max TG/BG {np.max(abs(q.col("k_2400_tg_curr")))*1e12:.0f}/'
          f'{np.max(abs(q.col("k_2400_bg_curr")))*1e12:.0f} pA')
for ax in axs[-1]: ax.set_xlabel('B (T)')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## Runs 6–7 — onset and frequency content

Use `sdh_onset` and degree-5 `sdh_fft` after the raw traces, with three low-B cuts to expose background sensitivity. Run 6 has a strong ~7 T component and higher-frequency content near ~22–30 T; several peaks sit near integer multiples of ~7 T, so their status as independent pockets is unresolved. The onset finder gives ~0.88 T when run 6's recorded 0.05 T low edge is included; its ~7 T track itself appears above threshold near ~1.35 T, and low-field coarse sampling makes the onset uncertain. Run 7 shows ~5–12 T content but only reaches |n|=1.2×10¹² on the hole side, the low-density exception regime of the tetralayer model. Neither spot check alone supports a stacking verdict; the electron fan will test each branch's density trajectory and the Luttinger sum.

# FFT after raw inspection. The lower cutoff is varied to expose sensitivity
# to the MR background; no stacking classification is made on these spectra.
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, sdh_fft
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 7), sharex=True)
for row, (fid, n, bmin) in enumerate(((6, +3.2, 0.05), (7, -1.2, 0.30))):
    q = run(fid)
    B = q.col('magnet_field')
    R = q.col('sr1_X') / (q.col('sr0_X') / -1e6)
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, b_lo=bmin, f_min=5, r_full_scale=5000)
    print(f'run {fid}: {on.summary()}')
    for cut in (1.0, 1.5, 2.0):
        f, S = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(cut, 10.0), log=False, nfft=4096)
        axs[row].plot(f, S[0] / np.nanmax(S[0]), label=f'B ≥ {cut:.1f} T')
    FL = luttinger_frequency(abs(n) * 1e16)  # n listed in 1e12 cm^-2; helper takes m^-2
    axs[row].axvline(FL, color='k', lw=1, ls=':', label=f'F_L={FL:.1f} T')
    axs[row].set(ylabel='normalized FFT amplitude', title=f'run {fid}: n={n:+.1f}e12')
    axs[row].legend(fontsize=8)
axs[-1].set(xlim=(0, 65), xlabel='frequency (T)')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — electron D = 0 Landau fan for the stacking call (`landau-fan-vti`)

> **05:27** · landau-fan-vti: D=0 electron n +3.2 to +2.4e12 (20), B +0.9 to +10 T (102 uniform-1/B rows), sr1 100 uV, 2.1 s/pt, Vsi 0 · **ETA ~08:27** (≈3h)

Runs 6–7 completed without gate leakage or clipping. The +3.2×10¹² electron check (run 6, B_1–B_2) has oscillations and candidate ~7 and ~22–30 T content, but the higher peaks may be harmonics of ~7 T; the hole check (run 7) reaches only −1.2×10¹², where the model's near-CNP hole tones overlap. The fan therefore follows the electron side and tests how the peaks move with density, rather than assigning stacking from one trace. Run 5's region-A calibration fixes the D = 0 gate line; the absolute density scale is still the geometry prior, and region B's ~0.43×10¹² density offset may superpose tones on this one contact pair.

The fixed-D line covers **n = +3.2→+2.4×10¹² cm⁻²**, TG **+0.984→+0.754 V**, BG **+1.166→+0.870 V**, V_Si = 0. The density window excludes the low-|n| electron exception where ABAB can mimic an ABCA singleton, and it excludes the hole side because its available density cannot test the separated-pair regime. Field is **+0.9→+10.0 T**, 102 rows uniform in 1/B; the magnet begins at ~0 T and first ramps bare to +0.9 T (~6.6 min), then traverses 9.1 T while measuring (~66.4 min bare ramp floor). The 20-point gate line is paired, descending in n. At n_max, F_L = 33.1 T and Δ(1/B)=0.01001 T⁻¹ gives 3.02 samples per fastest period; at B_min, Δn=0.0421×10¹² is below half the fourfold LL ray spacing (0.0435×10¹²). The 1/B window is 1.011 T⁻¹ (δF≈0.99 T if signal survives from 0.9 T); run 6's ~7 T track was robust only from ~1.35 T, for which the usable δF worsens to ~1.56 T and the weak partner may have fewer than five periods in low-n columns. A missing partner there will be reported as unresolved, not absent.

Fixed sr1 sensitivity **100 µV** gives ~10 kΩ nominal full scale at 10 nA: run 6's 10 T maximum was 530 Ω at n=3.2; the lower-n/high-B corner controls headroom and gets an automatic 90%-range abort. The fast-axis dwell is **2.1 s** (7τ for the recorded 0.3 s / 24 dB lock-in), and the blocking field driver adds its 3 s settle per row. Price: 2,040 points × ~2.27 s/point from run 5's 1.17 s/point at 1.0 s dwell ≈77 min, plus 73 min field traverse, ~5 min row settles, turnarounds and 10% margin → **~3 h**. Check the first 2–3 rows for leakage, rail, live current and field progression; check near 3, 6 and 8 T for developing density-tracking oscillations. A sustained rail, leak trip, or dead channel stops the fan; after any abort, read actual field and gates before another move. The fan ends at +10 T with gates at n=+2.4 for a possible high-field follow-up; no hidden return traverse is charged to this cell.

# Electron D=0 per-column SdH fan: region-A calibration from gatemap run 5.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.7960593093052633e-3, c_bg=2.160696465377614e-3,
           n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)
N_LO, N_HI, D0 = 2.4, 3.2, 0.0  # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
N_N, N_B, B_START, B_END = 20, 102, 0.9, 10.0
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.1, 0.0
SENS, I_TRIP = 100e-6, 1e-9

# Preconditions: these are state the fan assumes but does not set. Print the
# readback before any instrument write; a mismatch raises before the field moves.
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"],
                        max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T, _Tv = T_sample(), T_vaporizer()
_B, _tg, _bg, _si = magnet.field(), k_tg.volt(), k_bg.volt(), k_si()
_ps, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
_h1, _h2 = heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range()
_dc_range, _dc_out = dc205.voltage_range(), dc205.output()
print(f"preconditions: T_sample={_T:.3f} K (1.0..1.5), T_vaporizer={_Tv:.3f} K (0.7..1.5), "
      f"B={_B:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), TG={_tg:+.4f}, BG={_bg:+.4f}, Si={_si:+.4f} V (all 0); "
      f"PS={_ps}, output={_out} (both True), heater ranges={_h1}/{_h2} (0/0), "
      f"DC205 range/output={_dc_range}/{_dc_out} (2/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T <= 1.5 and 0.7 <= _Tv <= 1.5
assert abs(_B) < 0.05 and abs(_tg) < 0.01 and abs(_bg) < 0.01 and abs(_si) < 0.01
assert _ps and _out and _h1 == 0 and _h2 == 0 and _dc_range == 2 and _dc_out == 1
assert (TG_MIN, TG_MAX, BG_MIN, BG_MAX, SI_MIN, SI_MAX) == (-0.3, 1.0, -1.3, 2.0, -25.0, 25.0)
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0 and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.0
_tau, _slope = sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"settling/bias: sr1 tau={_tau} s (0.3), slope={_slope} dB/oct (24), "
      f"drive={sr1.amplitude()} V (1.0), sr0 sens={sr0.sensitivity()} V (0.02)")
assert _tau == 0.3 and _slope == 24 and abs(sr1.amplitude()-1.0) < 0.01
assert abs(sr0.sensitivity()-0.02) < 1e-9

ns = np.linspace(N_HI, N_LO, N_N)
Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, **CAL)
B_vec = 1.0 / np.linspace(1.0/B_START, 1.0/B_END, N_B)
assert np.all((TG_MIN <= Vtgs) & (Vtgs <= TG_MAX))
assert np.all((BG_MIN <= Vbgs) & (Vbgs <= BG_MAX))
assert np.all((0 < B_vec) & (B_vec <= B_SESSION_CAP))
for v in Vtgs: k_tg.volt.vals.validate(float(v))
for v in Vbgs: k_bg.volt.vals.validate(float(v))
for b in B_vec: magnet.field.vals.validate(float(b))
_nr, _dr = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, **CAL)
assert np.max(abs(_nr - ns)) < 1e-4 and np.max(abs(_dr)) < 1e-4
_inv_step = abs(1/B_vec[1] - 1/B_vec[0])
_FL = 33.0848  # h*n_max/(4e), n_max=3.2e12 cm^-2
_half_ray = 0.0435238  # 0.5*(4e/h)*B_start in 1e12 cm^-2
assert _inv_step <= 1/(3*_FL) and abs(ns[1]-ns[0]) <= _half_ray
print(f"grid: {N_B} B rows {B_vec[0]:.3f}->{B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, "
      f"d(1/B)={_inv_step:.5f} 1/T; {N_N} n points {ns[0]:+.2f}->{ns[-1]:+.2f}e12, "
      f"Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f}->{Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f}->{Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V")

# The first field move is a bare blocking ramp from the verified ~0 T state.
# Every subsequent row moves monotonically upward; no return ramp is hidden.
magnet.field(float(B_vec[0]))
print(f"positioned B={magnet.field():+.4f} T (target {B_START:+.3f})")
assert abs(magnet.field() - B_START) < 0.02
sr1.sensitivity(SENS)
print(f"sr1 sensitivity={sr1.sensitivity()} V (100 uV), fast delay={FAST_DELAY} s")

mc = dict(meas_config)
mc["Si (V)"] = _si
mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti: electron D=0 (run-5 region-A cal), n {N_HI:+.2f}->{N_LO:+.2f}e12 "
                  f"({N_N} pts), B {B_START:+.2f}->{B_END:+.2f} T ({N_B} uniform-1/B rows), "
                  f"fast_delay {FAST_DELAY}s, sr1 sens {SENS*1e6:.0f}uV, Vsi 0")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'electron side; D={D0:+.3f} V/nm; n={N_HI:+.2f} to {N_LO:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, '
              f'TG={Vtgs[0]:+.4f} to {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f} V, BG={Vbgs[0]:+.4f} to {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V; '
              f'B={B_START:+.2f} to {B_END:+.2f} T, {N_B} uniform-1/B rows; '
              f'run-5 ratio={CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.4f}, n_offset={CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, '
              f'D_offset={CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; fast_delay={FAST_DELAY}s; sr1={SENS*1e6:.0f}uV')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbgs[0]))
s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtgs[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)

# Row: [time, B, TG, BG, T_sample, TGcurr, BGcurr, sr0X, sr0P, sr1X, sr1P].
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot('time', T_sample)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    itg, ibg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    vx = abs(float(data[9]))
    if itg > I_TRIP or ibg > I_TRIP or vx > 0.9*SENS:
        print(f"FAN TRIP B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, TG={float(data[2]):+.3f}, BG={float(data[3]):+.3f} V: "
              f"|I_tg|={itg:.2e}, |I_bg|={ibg:.2e} A, |sr1X|={vx:.2e} V")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                 slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
# Intentional endpoint: +10 T, n=+2.4e12; this leaves field for a follow-up.
print(f"fan done: B={magnet.field():+.4f} T, TG={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, BG={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V")

# === SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0 (region-A calibration), B 0 -> 10 T ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---

# === Kernel-binding probe (read-only) ===
# First E1 act after the grant: confirms the nb-collab execute path lands on the
# operator's instrument-carrying kernel (the one that ran Setup + SAFETIES), not
# a fresh python3 kernel. Touches no instrument — namespace only.
import os
_need = ['magnet', 'heater', 'sr0', 'sr1', 'sr2', 'sr3', 'k_2400_tg', 'k_2400_bg',
         'dc205', 'k_tg', 'k_bg', 'k_si', 'T_sample', 'T_vaporizer', 'meas_config',
         'WIRING', 'state0', 'cal', 'B_SESSION_CAP', 'T_SESSION_CAP', 'tg_lims', 'bg_lims']
_missing = [n for n in _need if n not in globals()]
print(f"pid {os.getpid()} | main_dir {main_dir if 'main_dir' in globals() else '<unset>'}")
print(f"present: {len(_need) - len(_missing)}/{len(_need)} | missing: {_missing}")
print("KERNEL PROBE:", "BOUND" if not _missing else "UNBOUND")
